note: Fixed before any model run. Copied from docs/evidence/1814-skill-invocation/conditions.json (condition I) and reduced to the two conditions of the owner decision (Issue #1817, 2026-11-25). Both conditions start from the same synthetic sample project and the same base CLAUDE.md, install ASC with the documented user steps (project-assets --register-claude-skill --apply) and adopt the read trigger the project-assets plan proposes (--adopt-read-trigger, option claude-md). They differ only in the tarball installed (release.json): B = released v0.5.109, S = the candidate packed at commit ee77daa0 (the edits of 4c95f8d4, asc narrowed in ee77daa0) whose only content difference is the two Skill bodies.
modelNote: Same as #1814 (the `sonnet` alias). The resolved model id (init event) is recorded per trial. Not changed after results are seen (decision-criteria.md).

budget.note: Owner cap 15 USD (Host-computed, Issue #1817 comment 2026-11-25). run-trial.mjs takes these values only (no --stop-usd/--budget arguments) and refuses a trial when the ledger total plus perTrialUsd exceeds capUsd - safetyMarginUsd. perTrialUsd is the --max-budget-usd of every trial, the same as #1814 and the same in both conditions.

runsNote: Planned repetitions per condition and case. score.mjs scores rep numbers 1..runs; a later rep number counts only as the one-time replacement of a failed trial of the same condition and case (decision-criteria.md), anything else is reported separately.
